comment: Config for the projection experiment (the hub: per-component logit projections feeding generalizability and steering). Migrated from proj_attn.py / proj_neuron.py.

attn.comment: All heads, all train examples (no per-subtask cap) — matches proj_attn.py.

neuron.comment: proj_neuron.py uses only the first 50 train examples/sub-task ('to reduce the time') and a top/bottom-50 static filter. Both preserved as documented defaults (CLAUDE.md hard-rule 2).
